build_autoencoder_oobleck: build an AutoencoderOobleck model to encode audio waveforms into latents and decode them back
encode_audio_with_oobleck: encode audio waveform tensors into latent distributions using AutoencoderOobleck encode method
decode_latents_with_oobleck: decode latent tensors back into audio waveforms using AutoencoderOobleck decode method
create_oobleck_residual_unit: create an OobleckResidualUnit with configurable dimension and dilation for audio processing
create_snake1d_activation: create a Snake1d activation function module with learnable alpha and beta parameters
